design: Perhead kmeans of concatenated normalized pre-rotary final q/q2, without labels or outcomes. First4 lexicalpairs/domain train,last4 evaluate. Prototype-conditioned end-relative coefficient means; uncovered distances fall back to discovery pooled-distance mean. Compare local routing and persistent-write errors, not causal fidelity. Native keys/values not used in clustering; coefficient targets are discovery routing. Context labels used only retrospective reporting/baseline.
